messages.message: Class NightWorksIO\MutationGate\Core\Planted\Bad is neither abstract nor final.
Method NightWorksIO\MutationGate\Core\Planted\Bad::run() has no return type specified.
Method NightWorksIO\MutationGate\Core\Planted\Bad::run() has parameter $x with no type specified.
Calling strlen() is forbidden, L3 — a path, a test name or a message is text, and a byte function splits a multibyte character in half. Use the mb_* equivalent (L3).
H5 — build this with sprintf rather than concatenation. Concatenation spreads the shape of the string across the values going into it; sprintf keeps it in one literal (H5).
Parameter #1 $string of function strlen expects string, array|float|int|string|false|null given.
Using the else control structure is forbidden, C5 — no `else`. Return from the condition that refuses and let the rest carry on at one indent; where both branches are answers, write a match (C5).
